jordan: Quick sync — we need to lock down timing for the AdapterLib marketplace listing + LangChain connector announcement. Are we aiming for next Wed release window? /cc @nina @ryan
jordan: Also need to confirm SI briefing timeline and whether the hardware partner wants a joint tweet.
nina: Next Wed (3/31) is tight for legal review from their side. Can we move to Apr 7?
ryan: Implementation wise, engineering can ship the gateway shim by Apr 2 if we freeze the API by Mar 26.
linh: We still need to add auth header passthrough and a small retry policy. Estimate 3 dev days.
chris: Marketing wants a co-blog and a joint webinar. If we pick Apr 7, we can do blog + 1-week webinar promo (Apr 14).
jordan: Sounds like Apr 7 is the target. Action items: legal signoff (nina), API freeze (chris/jordan), eng deliverables (linh/ryan), SI partner brief (jordan).
nina: Filing NDA follow-ups today. pinging legal: https://redwood.internal/legal/ndas  :eyes:
ryan: Quick note — gateway shim config draft:
```
adapter:
  name: adapterlib-redwood
  auth: bearer
  timeout_ms: 12000
  prefix_cache: true
```
linh: I can add retry/backoff and a small integ test using Orchestrator v2. Will post PR by EOD Thu.
integration-bot: New integration checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/checklists/adapterlib-integration — items 3/7 done
chris: Copy for joint blog due Mar 29. I'll draft outline and tag marketing.
jordan: Great. I'll schedule a cross-team call Mon 3/25 10am PT. If anything blocks earlier, drop notes here. :thumbsup:
nina: adding calendar event now.
ryan: will prepare demo video snip for the webinar.
linh: flag — hardware partner (NumaAccelerate) asked for perf numbers on A100 vs Numa-8. I'll run baseline tests this week and attach results.
jordan: 👍 thanks all. We'll sync Monday.
